problem: The cross-reference "see Unit 5" is loose and is not a chapter link, so a student reading on a phone cannot jump to it and may not know which chapter is meant. The sentence also implies responsible AI is just another name for LLM ethics, which is broader than that.
fix: Replace with a proper link to the chapter that covers LLM ethics, for example: "Some syllabi call this responsible AI; language-model courses often treat it under LLM ethics, see LLM ethics." If no such chapter exists, delete the pointer and keep only the sentence defining responsible AI.

problem: "A watermark proves origin" is too strong. A watermark shows that the media passed through a particular tool or account; it can be forged, copied onto other media, or stripped, so presence and intactness are not proof of who truly made the content.
fix: Say: "A watermark gives evidence of which tool produced the media when it is present and intact; it can be removed or forged, so it does not prove who made the content and it does not detect unmarked fakes."
